semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized components and solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai JUYA Technology Co., Ltd offers a comprehensive range of products and solutions for the semiconductor manufacturing sector, focusing on high-purity and specialized components. Their offerings include PFA lined tube valves, fittings, tubing, pressure sensors, and micro-welded components, all designed to meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor fabrication and related industries.
capabilities: PFA lined tube valves and fittings
High-purity pressure and differential pressure gauges
Explosion-proof and digital display pressure sensors
Micro-welded components for ultra-high pressure applications
